svg.title: sx pnpm vitest run -u src/auth.test.ts
svg.desc: A terminal running sx pnpm vitest run -u src/auth.test.ts. Vitest's output streams back as if it ran locally: src/auth.test.ts, 12 tests passed, 2 snapshots updated. spotexec then prints one summary line: 4.1s on aws#3 (ran on a Spot VM), synced 4 files (18 KB) (sent only what changed), pulled 2 modified files (wrote the snapshots back).
